name: REN - DEV - UTIL-01 - Salesforce Routing Resolve_quicklink

parameters.content:
## REN - DEV - UTIL-01 - Salesforce Routing Resolve

Internal/test utility for WF-03. Resolves inbound routing against Salesforce sandbox:

GET /services/apexrest/quicklink/v1/routing/resolve

Inputs: phone (E.164) or accountId. Business result is in body.status, even on HTTP 200.

Expected env vars:
- RENOV_INTERNAL_TOKEN
- SALESFORCE_DEV_CLIENT_ID
- SALESFORCE_DEV_CLIENT_SECRET
- SALESFORCE_DEV_BASE_URL (optional; defaults to Salesforce sandbox URL provided for integration)
- SALESFORCE_DEV_TOKEN_URL (optional)

Do not store Consumer Key/Secret in workflow JSON.
